_comment: CAVE BIOMES IN POCKETS. Underground biomes take their box only where the climate lies inside it (CaveBiomeContainmentMixin), so continentalness decides where dripstone_caves (>= 0.8) can appear. Two underground-only terms, both blended in by depth (terra_continental:depth: 0 at depth 0.1, full by 0.3; underground biomes live at depth 0.2-0.9), so surface biomes and terrain are untouched. 1) CAP (the inner add): the spline maps full_continents 0.5 -> 0.3, 1.0 -> 0.5 and 1.5 -> 0.6, so ordinary inland caves stay below dripstone's box and keep the biome their climate picks at the surface. 2) POCKETS (the outer add): terra_continental:cave_pocket_dripstone, a 3-D noise with features of several hundred blocks, pulls continentalness toward 1.0 where it passes 0.3 (full by 0.55): dripstone caves come in pockets about 600 m across, about 1 km apart, separated by plain caves. Terra Continental's radial bumps push inland full_continents to ~1.48; full_continents itself must NOT be changed because initial_density_without_jaggedness, sloped_cheese, roughness and factor/islands all read it. argument1 and the copy inside argument2 both hold the capped value (written out twice: density functions have no let). SHORE BIOMES ONLY AT THE SHORE: argument1 is terra_continental:shape/continents_biome, full_continents lifted to at least -0.1 (out of vanilla's coast band, -0.19 to -0.11) where the ground's offset passes 0.05 -> 0.12 (about +20 -> +50). The coast remap raises mountains on ground whose biome continentalness is still in the coast band, and vanilla's coast slice at low erosion is stony_shore, so without the lift flat Stony Shore turns up high in coastal mountains. 2-D and biome selection only (terrain reads full_continents and shape/continents, never this router entry); the cave compression below still reads the unlifted value. Generated by preview/shape_pack.py (high_coast_biomes).
